note: Each .lolo-derived case is the lowered program of a small fixture (the files rui-g-*.lolo in the batch scratch dir) whose expected findings were taken from `orb validate --json` (the Rust check) and equal what `orb lint rui-effects` reports. The patterns step feeds the registry subset (real prop types) the node-typed-prop test reads. The object-form, root-string, one-element and ref-trait cases are written from render_ui/mod.rs because the installed validate crashes in another lint on object-form effects. ORB_EFF_SLOT_CONFLICT is not ported: slots_per_transition is a HashSet, so no count is ever above one and the code never fires (reproduced: two render-ui to main in one transition report nothing).

findings.message: @trait binding '@trait.Inner' appears in prop 'gap' of pattern 'stack'; allowed positions are `children: [...]` and `node`-typed props
findings.suggestion: Move the @trait reference into a `children:` array — e.g. delete the `gap:` prop and add `@trait.Inner` as an element of the enclosing `children: [ …, @trait.Inner ]` (custom props like `gap` are not slots) — or use a pattern prop that accepts a node (e.g. `front`, `back`)
